Name: Mizu's Emu
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Do your ostriches need a birdy friend to keep them company in the barn with all your hoofstock? This mod is for you if you like all things about emu! It adds emu as a new [b]barn[/b] or [b]coop[/b][b] [/b]animal based on preference.

[list]
[*]Emu lay [b]Emu Eggs[/b] every five days.[/*]
[*](Configurable) Make five jars of [b]Mayonnaise[/b] or [b]Emu Mayonnaise [/b]in the [b]Mayonnaise Machine[/b] based on preference.[/*]
[*]Emu are a late game friend! [b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you unlock [b]Ginger Island[/b] and complete the [b]Special Order: E(gg) for Education.[/b] [/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod when COOPS are selected over BARNS.[/b] It allows the animal to squeeze through the small door of the coops.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 2 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ emu meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead or become flexible if you have it turned on in Cornucopia.

This mod has optional effects with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] installed to change the text of the recipe book when learning. It's entirely aesthetic.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img]﻿[/b][/center]
By default, Emu Eggs make 5 jars of Mayonnaise and Emus live in Barns. You can toggle different selections below.

[b]Enable Emu Mayonnaise [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables Emu Mayonnaise to match mods which add Ostrich Mayonnaise for ostriches.
[b]Enable Live in Coop[/b] (false by default): Allows the emu to live in buildings set up as Deluxe Coops instead of Deluxe Barns to match mods which move ostriches to coops. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required.
[b]Disable Meat Recipes [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] False by default, turn on to remove meat-based recipes/books. Primarily for users who play with Animal Husbandry without having meat/butchering turned on and just want treats support.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img]
[/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] if you want Emus to live in Coops instead of Barns
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
